messages:
Sarah: Heads-up — AcmeCloud wants hourly usage reports per-region in their local tz (not UTC). They need entitlements mapped to partner_sku and a 72h backfill for cutover. Spec: https://acme.example.com/specs/hourly-usage
Marco: Can we get a sample payload? need to confirm fields we send.
Sarah: Sure — sample:
```
{
  "customer_id": "cust_123",
  "region": "us-west-2",
  "usage_window_start": "2026-02-25T08:00:00Z",
  "usage_window_end": "2026-02-25T09:00:00Z",
  "usage_window_end_tz": "America/Los_Angeles",
  "tokens_used": 12345,
  "entitlement_map": [{ "redwood_entitlement": "embed_small", "partner_sku": "ACME-EMB-S" }]
}
```
Priya: Important — billing wants timezone normalization rule. do we floor to partner timezone start? Also rounding policy for partial hours?
Ben: We can emit partner_tz windows. Backend can compute local-window by adding "usage_window_end_tz" and a numeric offset. For partial hours we currently prorate to seconds and round up at 30s. Is that acceptable?
Tina: Partner contract requires hourly bucket aligned to their local hour boundary and prorate by seconds. They also want entitlement id mapping CSV; can we provide mapping by tomorrow?
Marco: I'll add transformation in the marketplace adapter to include usage_window_end_tz and partner_sku. PR by EOD.
Ben: I'll schedule a one-off backfill job for 72h and add a safeguard to avoid double-ingest. Will open ticket INF-678.
Priya: Need a mapping doc for finance — @Marco can you drop the CSV here when ready?
Sarah: I'll confirm cutover time with Acme — suggest Thu 22:00 PT to minimize impact. Also toggles: we'll start with event-level delivery and switch to hourly rollups after verification.
MarketplaceBot: webhook delivery failed for acme-proxy (403) — last attempt 1745004350. Will retry in 2m.
Marco: noted. I'll add retry header and auth fix in the adapter.
Tina: I'll ping partner to check their firewall rules.
Sarah: Action list: Marco = adapter + mapping CSV; Ben = backfill job + INF ticket; Priya = finalize rounding policy; Tina = confirm partner firewall and cutover. Meeting if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
Ben: INF-678 created: https://redwood.internal/issue/INF-678
Sarah: Thanks — keep updates in this thread.
